text:
Maya: Heads up — we push webinar retargeting tomorrow 9am PT. Need search bid/daypart plan + creative swap for retargeting ads.
Ethan: Got it. What's target CPL for webinar signups?
Maya: Target CPL $45. Brand search CPLs are lower but we want registrations >3k attendees.
Priya: For retargeting, I recommend 30d window for warm and 7d for recent viewers. We'll use dynamic headlines tied to webinar topic.
Jordan: Dayparting: increase bids 18:00-23:00 local US PT by +25%. Reduce daytime bids by -10% to keep spend steady.
Ethan: Can we move $1k/day from broad-branded into retargeting evening surge?
Maya: Yes — reallocate starting tonight. Also set freq cap 3 impressions per user per 7 days.
Priya: Creatives — swap hero images to speaker closeups; headlines A/B test: "Cut inference costs 3x" vs "Faster LLM inference without vendor lock-in". Also test CTA: "Reserve seat" vs "Register free".
Jordan: I'll update Google Ads. Ad copy + UTM pattern: utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=webinar_apr&utm_content={{headline_variant}}
Ethan: Quick note on conversion settings: use 7-day click, 1-day view attribution. Keep conversion action = webinar_registration.
Sam: Added change doc & checklist here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1XxExample (internal) — tagging Priya for final assets.
Maya: @Priya please upload final assets and alt headlines by 18:00 PT so we can QA creative rendering.
Priya: Will do. Sending draft images and headlines in 30m. :thumbsup:
AdBot: Campaign update scheduled — changes will roll at 00:15 UTC.
Jordan: After rollout I'll monitor CTR, CVR, and CPA hourly for first 12 hours. Will pause creatives if CVR drops >20% vs baseline.
Maya: Also mirror retargeting creative to paid social next week if performance holds.
Ethan: Reminder: enable audience expansion only on broad retargeting set, keep strict match on high-intent list.
Priya: Note for analytics: add custom dimension 'webinar_topic' to registration event so we can segment by headline.
Maya: Great. Thanks everyone — will update this thread when bids move and assets are live. :rocket:
